summary_en: Specific targets and metrics not disclosed in header notice. Detailed disclosure referenced in attached materials.
title_en: Notice regarding initiatives toward realizing management conscious of capital cost and share price
translation_en_brief: On 31 July 2026, TOKUDEN CO., LTD. (TSE Standard, ticker 3437) issued a notice announcing the preparation of materials describing its response to realizing management conscious of capital cost and share price. The main notice itself does not disclose specific metrics, targets, or timelines; detailed disclosure is contained in the attached materials referenced but not included in the header pages provided. The initiative appears to be a capital allocation or governance policy statement, with full terms to be found in the supplementary document.
